title: Ek Hassina Do Deewane
desc: Amar, an orthodox businessman marries Neeta; slowly he starts mentally torturing her which leads to their divorce. Amar makes a deal with Neeta before filing for a divorce. Will she agree?

title: Insaf Ka Tarazu
desc: Ramesh, a multi-millionaire, falls madly in love with Bharti. In the turnout of events, Bharti kills Ramesh. Watch the heart wrenching drama to know what compels her to take this dire step.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.
